Backend 14/14 pytest passing (test_iteration11.py, ~13s) covering: GET /editorial/activity shape with last_published.minutes_ago + counts_24h/7d + recent array (counts_7d>=counts_24h sanity), GET /articles/{slug}/post-reading 200 with similar+contradiction+topic + 404 on unknown slug, GET /me/highlights unauth → 401, GET authed → list, POST color uppercase 'GREEN' coerced to 'green' + persisted text/note/paragraph_index, POST invalid color 'red' coerced to 'yellow', POST unknown slug → 404, GET /me/highlights/{slug} filters correctly, PATCH updates note+color (verified via subsequent GET), PATCH/DELETE 404 on nonexistent id, DELETE 200 on real id (double-delete → 404), regression Make.com POST /api/articles still works, /me/saved/sync no collision with catch-all {slug} route. Frontend (Playwright via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): editorial-activity-strip visible on home with pulse dot + activity-last-updated 'ahora' + activity-counts-24h(2)/activity-counts-7d(2) + activity-latest-link clickable. Article /articulo/noxeal-report-las-tendencias-virales-que-sacudieron-la-red-esta-semana renders article-lead separate from article-body-highlightable, which has 9 paragraphs with data-paragraph-index. Mouse drag selection (75 chars) triggers highlight-popover with highlight-color-yellow/green/blue + highlight-cancel. Clicking yellow creates highlights-list with highlight-item-{id}; highlight-add-note-{id} → highlight-note-input-{id} → Enter persists highlight-note-{id} ('Mi nota de prueba iter11'); hover + highlight-remove-{id} + window.confirm accept removes item + shows 'Eliminado' toast. post-reading section renders 5 tiles (post-reading-save, post-reading-share, post-reading-saved, post-reading-follow-narrative for matched pillar 'Salud mental y redes', post-reading-contradiction with opposite fact_level article) + post-reading-similar with 4 post-similar-{slug} items. Clicking post-reading-save updates ArticleEngagement save button text to 'Guardado' via CustomEvent noxeal:toggle-save. /mis-notas unauth shows mis-notas-local-status (CloudOff: 'Guardado solo en este navegador') + mis-notas-group-{slug} with 1 mis-notas-item green highlight. After login as noxael18@gmail.com, /mis-notas shows mis-notas-sync-status 'Sincronizado en tu cuenta · Noxael' with green Cloud icon + 5 server-side highlights (from earlier pytest runs). No /mis-notas-empty when local items exist; CTA path verified via component logic.

critical_code_review_comments: HighlightIn field_validator(color, mode='before') correctly coerces ANY non-{yellow,green,blue} input to 'yellow' instead of 400 — defensive UX choice (matches spec: 'red' → yellow).

GET /me/highlights/{slug} is registered AFTER GET /me/highlights — FastAPI matches correctly because the non-param route takes precedence; verified by hitting /me/highlights (returns array) vs /me/highlights/{seed_slug} (returns filtered array).
POST /me/highlights performs an article existence check with PUBLIC_STATUS_FILTER before insert — prevents orphaned highlights on draft/deleted articles. Good.

editorial/activity: minutes_ago handles missing/malformed published_at with try/except returning None — robust. counts_24h/7d use isoformat string comparison, which is correct for ISO-8601 lexicographic ordering.
post-reading similar query uses $or on tags+category — generous match. Limit 4 + sort by published_at -1 matches the 'newest first' spec.
contradiction lookup uses opposite_map for fact_level family (rumor↔confirmed/investigation, etc.) — single fetch, may return null if no opposite exists; UI tile conditionally renders. Good.
PILLAR_TOPICS lookup is in-memory (no DB hit) — fast.
PATCH only accepts note+color fields (text/paragraph_index immutable post-creation) — sensible.

Anonymous-user fallback in HighlightLayer uses local-{timestamp}-{rand} ids in localStorage; merged with server highlights on auth so no data loss. Verified by seeing 1 local highlight pre-login + 5 server highlights post-login on same article slug grouping.
ArticleEngagement CustomEvent('noxeal:toggle-save') listener correctly forwards to internal toggleSave, keeping bookmark logic in one place — clean.
